0.original: Nedrick knows of a place where a skilled adventurer might hone <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> skills.

1.original: According to Nedrick, an area known as the Aurum Vale might hold a suitable challenge for an adventurer of your accomplishments. The vale may be found in the southwesterly reaches of the central highlands of Coerthas. Travel there and seek out a man by the name of Willielmus.

2.original: Willielmus reluctantly grants you entry to the Aurum Vale. Take up the challenge, but be ever mindful of the lethal fumes within!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※The Aurum Vale can be accessed via the Duty Finder.

24.original: Speak with Willielmus at the Aurum Vale.

48.original: I can't take two steps around this place without hearing <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> this, or <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> that. Why, it's as if you're some kind of godsdamned hero!

49.original: ...But I jest. Even I can see that you're just itching to find a new battleground to hone your skills. Fortunately, I know just the place: the Aurum Vale. Head southwest through the central highlands of Coerthas and seek out a man named Willielmus─and tell him that Nedrick sent you.

50.original: Hail, adventurer. Wait, do not tell me─Nedrick sent you.

51.original: Tell me this, adventurer─do you know how the Aurum Vale earned its most enticing name? Well, allow me to enlighten you.

52.original: The cave is rich with sulphur and mythril ore which, through reactions with the groundwater, combine to exude golden-hued fumes. A beautiful sight─that is, until you realize the damned death clouds are burning your chest from within.

53.original: If you still wish to take your life in your hands, I'll not be the one that stops you. But do try not to get killed─I've dragged enough corpses out of the vale to last me a lifetime.

54.original: You have unlocked the Duty Finder! This feature allows you to undertake multiplayer duties without having to form a party on your own.

55.original: To bring up the Duty Finder interface, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty Finder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>main menu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
